description: Add a getErrorSummary(error) helper function to src/llm.js that returns a short one-line string summarising an LLM error: include the provider name, HTTP status if present, and whether it was a rate limit

contract.raw_request: Add a getErrorSummary(error) helper function to src/llm.js that returns a short one-line string summarising an LLM error: include the provider name, HTTP status if present, and whether it was a rate limit
contract.goal: Implement the getErrorSummary function in src/llm.js that returns a formatted string with provider name, HTTP status, and rate limit status.
required_behavior: Implement the getErrorSummary function in src/llm.js
Return a one-line string in the format: 'Provider: [_PROVIDER ], Status: [_STATUS ], Rate Limit: [TRUE/FALSE]'
constraints: The function must be added to src/llm.js
The function must not cause any regressions in existing functionality
The function must return exactly the specified string format

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The function returns the correct string format
The function correctly includes the provider name
The function correctly includes the HTTP status
The function correctly includes the rate limit status

verification_plan: Run unit tests for getErrorSummary function
Inspect src/llm.js for the presence of the function
Verify the return value matches the expected format
Check that the function does not introduce any new errors
